inspector.main.1.deny.text: Written retest outcomes are issued only through the remediation records desk (remediation_records_desk) on the entry page once the registered job's reports exist, in order: inspection, repair, drying, then my independent retest. I cannot pre-report or mail a result, and a photo, a draft or another unit's passing test is never clearance evidence.
